name: Gloaming
sourceDistinctions: The player entry explicitly grants low-light vision. The core outsider type supplies 60-ft. darkvision.
Light Blindness applies to attack rolls, saving throws, and checks while in bright light, in addition to 1 round of blindness from abrupt exposure.
The core flight rule caps load at light. The racial entry gives no separate armor restriction.
Wizards’ collected archive has no Underdark errata file. The official FAQ has no Gloaming or Portal Sensitive entry.
portraitForm: Iskra Sablewing, an original Gloaming Sorcerer with luminescence off
